_note: Phase 9b predictive-candidate scaffold for personal_forecast (candidates do not surface in Year Ahead -- Personal Forecast only, per phase0/04_convergence_and_candidate_protocol.md section 10). Key path: candidate_domain -> leading independent_method_family -> block string (matches select_block('personal_forecast', 'predictive_candidates', domain, leading_family) once wired). ~50 words each. Second person. Same hedged/research framing requirement as predictive_chapters.json -- candidates specifically must never read as a settled prediction (phase0/04 section 4.3, section 10). Family list is the real independence_group values from engine/returns.py (return_family_<body>, not the charter prose's return_family_solar/lunar -- a documentation mismatch found during scaffolding, code is ground truth), engine/zodiacal_releasing.py (zr_family_<lot>), and engine/progressions.py / solar_arc.py / predictive_engine.py (the flat *_family names). return_family_generic and zr_family_generic exist as rare code fallbacks (secondary-body returns, unmatched clock roles) and are intentionally NOT given a full domain grid here -- they route through the family-level fallback below instead, consistent with select_block's own fallback-key mechanism, so nothing 404s at runtime for the rare case without doubling the scaffold size.

Look for a decision that helps you stand behind shared money, emotional exposure, endings, secrets, and psychological repair with more coherence.
transformation.return_family_moon: An emotional reset may form around shared resources, intimacy, grief, and deep change, especially where habit has been carrying more weight than conscious choice. Watch your body’s first response to shared money, emotional exposure, endings, secrets, and psychological repair. What soothes you, drains you, or pulls you home will be more informative than theory.
transformation.return_family_jupiter: An opening may appear around shared resources, intimacy, grief, and deep change, but its value depends on whether it gives you real room or only a larger version of an old demand. Follow access, support, and generosity, then check whether shared money, emotional exposure, endings, secrets, and psychological repair can expand without losing proportion.
transformation.return_family_saturn: A responsibility marker may gather around shared resources, intimacy, grief, and deep change. This does not automatically mean restriction; it may show where a promise, boundary, or structure has to become more adult. Pay attention to what shared money, emotional exposure, endings, secrets, and psychological repair requires over time, not only what it asks from you today.
transformation.progression_family: Slow inner development may be changing your relationship with shared resources, intimacy, grief, and deep change. The outer event may look minor, while the internal threshold is larger than it first appears. Track the difference between the version of you that once handled shared money, emotional exposure, endings, secrets, and psychological repair and the one arriving now.
transformation.solar_arc_family: A directional marker may make shared resources, intimacy, grief, and deep change feel newly visible or newly consequential. This candidate often shows up as a clean turn in emphasis rather than a dramatic event. Notice whether dealing with what has leverage over you suddenly becomes easier to name, schedule, publish, or defend.
transformation.profection_family: This annual chapter may be using shared resources, intimacy, grief, and deep change as one of its teaching rooms. The point is not constant intensity; it is repeated relevance. Keep notes on how shared money, emotional exposure, endings, secrets, and psychological repair keeps returning in different forms, because the repetition may be the message.
transformation.zr_family_fortune: Circumstances may be moving the story of shared resources, intimacy, grief, and deep change even before your preferences are settled. Watch the practical sequence around shared money, emotional exposure, endings, secrets, and psychological repair: who calls, what changes hands, what closes, what opens. The candidate is strongest when events create a path you did not design.
transformation.zr_family_spirit: Your agency may become the deciding factor around shared resources, intimacy, grief, and deep change. This candidate is less about what lands in your lap and more about the choice you keep circling. The useful question is: What needs to be released, renegotiated, or witnessed before trust can deepen?
